d: Pakistan faces growing unrest as thousands protest in Karachi, with Sindhi nationalists demanding independence and the creation of a separate 'Sindhu Desh'. The protests come amid reports of a plan to split the country's four provinces into 12–15 smaller units, triggering warnings of bloodshed from political leaders. Meanwhile, India has strongly condemned escalating Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, including strikes targeting Riyadh's financial district and the Ras Tanura oil refinery. With Indian nationals injured and millions living across the Gulf, New Delhi has reaffirmed its support…
